instruction: Implement normalize_record(record). Input must be a dict; name, amount and date values must be strings or None. Ignore other keys. Trim whitespace. Return exactly name (trimmed or empty string), amount_cents (integer cents or None for missing/blank), and day (ISO YYYY-MM-DD or None for missing/blank). Amounts accept an optional sign, decimal digits and optionally a dot with one or two decimal digits; preserve cents exactly and reject other forms with ValueError. Dates accept strictly YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY and must be valid calendar dates; invalid dates raise ValueError. Non-dict records and non-string/non-None field values raise TypeError. Do not change the callable interface.
